meta.coverage: All India, Rural; the 92 classes of the 2024 basket
meta.note: Base 2024=100, a separate series from the 2012 base — never spliced. Headline is the published all-groups index (CPI General): the API serves no component weights for this base yet, so the computed-from-weights cross-check the 2012-base bundles get is not possible here. y/y is computed from published index levels; the API's own published inflation rate is kept as a crosscheck.
meta.revisionPolicy: CPI is final on release; never revised.
